title: Candlelight: Christmas Classics
seo_title: Candlelight: Christmas Classics at Stone Chapel, Springfield
description: Candlelight: Christmas Classics is a live Christmas music concert held by candlelight at Stone Chapel at Drury University. The Candlelight series presents live, multi-sensory musical experiences in distinctive locations around Springfield. It runs from Friday, December 18, 2026 at 8:30 PM to Sunday, December 20, 2026 at 8:45 PM at 900 N Benton Ave, Springfield, MO.
